questions.topic: Why photon energy does not depend on brightness
questions.stem: Interpreting a graph, explain why doubling brightness does not double photon energy.

answer.exemplar: Doubling brightness doubles the number of photons, not their individual energy, because photon energy is fixed by frequency.

questions.explanation: Brightness scales photon count. The tempting idea that each photon gains energy is wrong.
